commands.output: H8 feasibility passed: overlapping reservations, exact-end quantity/available, same-account self-funding rejection, cancellation as-of oracle

model_proved.scheduled_run: Reserve input quantity from available at planned_start. At end, apply one net source membership with quantity = output - input, available = output, and a separate gross_input measure. The input's available debit and reservation release cancel at end; output adds available stock.
model_proved.cancellation: Before or exactly at planned_start removes all effects. After start and before end releases the hold at cancelled_at without consuming physical stock or publishing output. Cancellation at or after end is rejected.
model_proved.same_account: An output at end cannot fund the run's earlier start reservation; an opened same-account case coalesces physical input and output at exact end.
model_proved.availability_guard: Overlapping reservations and an ordinary debit against held stock reject atomically, with unchanged source rows and roots.

cases: Two overlapping reservations exceeding opening stock reject in both record-ID orders.
Physical quantity remains unchanged during the run while available reflects the hold.
At exact end, physical input is consumed and the hold is released without an intermediate record-ID prefix.
Same-account input/output and no-opening-stock self-funding attempt.
Ordinary stock debit cannot spend reserved availability.
Cancellation before start, at start, after start, and at scheduled end, with as-of assertions and rollback checks.
limitations: This is a disposable feasibility fixture, not H8 production integration or a migration.

The fixture extends the current compiled adapter and event dispatch only for its H8 source rows; its generated stock-root peer types contain only fixture nodes. Mixed H8 and existing stock movement node layouts remain unproved.
The debit case uses the fixture h8_stock_debit writer, not the production stock_out, stock_return, stock_transfer, purchase_receipt, assembly_input, or assembly_output paths.
Date shifts, downstream output-use capacity, full recipe child generation, concurrency, fan-out measurements, and broad regression probes remain open for H8 integration.
next: Implement H8 in the production accounting profile. Add available deltas to every direct stock-history writer and validate available.instant_min >= 0 on the stock root. Keep physical minimum_quantity separate. Use one net end membership per causal source at an owner/timestamp unless a disposable probe proves a supported alternative. Then test date shifts, reservations and ordinary stock-outs, cancellation, output-use capacity, exact-time oracles, and regressions.
